trent-s7-baptism-canon3-en: Does the Roman Church, as mother and mistress of all churches, hold the true doctrine concerning the sacrament of baptism?
trent-s7-confirmation-canon3-en: Is the bishop alone the ordinary minister of holy confirmation, rather than any simple priest?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon3-en: Are the seven sacraments unequal in worth, so that one may be more worthy than another?
trent-s7-baptism-canon4-en: Is baptism given by heretics in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost, with the intention of doing what the Church does, true baptism?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon4-en: Are the sacraments of the New Law necessary unto salvation, so that without them or the desire of them people do not obtain justification by faith alone?
trent-s7-baptism-canon5-en: Is baptism necessary unto salvation, and not a free option?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon5-en: Were the sacraments instituted for more than the nourishing of faith alone?
trent-s7-baptism-canon6-en: Can someone who has been baptized lose grace by sinning, even while still believing?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon6-en: Do the sacraments of the New Law contain and confer the grace they signify on those who place no obstacle, rather than being mere outward signs of faith?
trent-s7-baptism-canon7-en: Are the baptized bound by baptism to observe the whole law of Christ, and not to faith alone?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon7-en: Is grace, so far as God's part is concerned, always given through the sacraments to all who receive them rightly?
trent-s7-baptism-canon8-en: Are the baptized bound to observe the precepts of holy Church, whether written or transmitted, and not freed from them by baptism itself?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon8-en: Is grace conferred by the sacraments of the New Law through the act performed, and not by faith alone in the divine promise?
trent-s7-baptism-canon9-en: Do vows made after baptism remain binding, rather than being voided by the promise already made in baptism?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon9-en: Is an indelible character imprinted on the soul in Baptism, Confirmation, and Order, so that those sacraments cannot be repeated?
trent-s7-baptism-canon10-en: Does the mere remembrance of baptism already received, with faith in it, remit all sins committed after baptism?
trent-s7-baptism-canon11-en: Must baptism that was true and rightly conferred be repeated when someone who denied the faith among unbelievers converts to penitence?
trent-s7-baptism-canon12-en: May people be baptized at ages other than that at which Christ was baptized, and not only at the very article of death?
trent-s7-baptism-canon13-en: Are little children, after baptism, to be reckoned among the faithful even without actual faith of their own, without being rebaptized later?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon13-en: Must the received and approved rites of the Catholic Church in administering the sacraments be kept, and not contemned, omitted at pleasure, or freely changed by pastors?
trent-s7-baptism-canon14-en: Must adults baptized as children be asked to ratify their sponsors' promises and, if they refuse, be left free from a Christian life except exclusion from the sacraments?
trent-s7-sacraments-proem-en: Do the sacraments of the Church begin, increase, or repair true justice, so that doctrine on them completes the teaching on Justification?
trent-s8-decree-concerning-the-translati: May the Council be translated from its present city because disease so endangers the prelates' lives that they cannot safely remain?
trent-s9-decree-for-the-prorogation-of-t: Did the Synod, assembled at Bologna after Trent, prorogue its session for pressing and legitimate causes under apostolic authority?
trent-s10-bull-for-the-resumption-of-the: Did Pope Julius III order the ecumenical Council begun at Trent to be brought back to that city to heal religious dissensions in Germany?
trent-s10-decree-for-the-prorogation-of-: Did the Synod at Bologna further prorogue the session on the Sacraments and Reformation because some Fathers had not yet arrived?
trent-s10-on-the-fourteenth-day-of-septe: Was the Session that was to be held the next day at Bologna prorogued during the good pleasure of the sacred Council?
trent-s11-decree-for-resuming-the-counci: Was the Council of Trent resumed, agreeably to the letters of the pope, so that further matters might be proceeded with?
trent-s11-indiction-of-the-next-session-: Was the next Session of the Council appointed to be held on the ensuing calends of September?
trent-s12-session-text-en: Did the Synod of Trent, in its second session under Julius III, proceed after German archbishops arrived, having earlier delayed for Germany's absence?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon1-en: Are the body and blood, together with the soul and divinity of Christ—and thus the whole Christ—truly, really, and substantially contained in the Eucharist, and not only as in a sign or figure?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon3-en: Is the whole Christ contained under each species of the Eucharist, and under every separated part of each species?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon4-en: Do Christ's body and blood remain in the Eucharist after consecration, both before and after reception, including in reserved hosts?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon5-en: Is the principal fruit of the Eucharist the remission of sins, to the exclusion of its other effects?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon6-en: Is Christ in the Eucharist to be adored with the worship of latria, including festive solemnity, processions, and public adoration?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon7-en: Is it lawful to reserve the sacred Eucharist in the sacrarium and to carry it with honour to the sick?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon8-en: Is Christ given in the Eucharist eaten not only spiritually, but also sacramentally and really?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon9-en: Are all the faithful of both sexes bound, once they reach years of discretion, to communicate at least every Easter?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon10-en: Is it lawful for the celebrating priest to communicate himself?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon11-en: Is faith alone a sufficient preparation for receiving the sacrament of the most holy Eucharist?
trent-s13-eucharist-ch1-en: After the consecration of bread and wine, is our Lord Jesus Christ, true God and man, truly, really, and substantially contained in the Eucharist under those species?
trent-s13-eucharist-ch2-en: Did Christ institute the Eucharist as spiritual food, an antidote against sin, a pledge of future glory, and a memorial of His death until He comes?
trent-s13-eucharist-ch3-en: Does the Eucharist excel the other sacraments because, before it is used, the Author of sanctity Himself is present under the species?
trent-s13-eucharist-ch4-en: By consecration, is the whole substance of bread and wine converted into Christ's body and blood—a conversion called Transubstantiation?
trent-s13-eucharist-ch5-en: May the faithful render to the most holy Eucharist the worship of latria due to the true God?
trent-s13-eucharist-ch6-en: Is the ancient custom of reserving the Eucharist in the sacrarium and carrying it to the sick to be retained?
trent-s13-eucharist-ch7-en: Must anyone conscious of mortal sin receive sacramental confession before approaching the Eucharist, however contrite he may seem?
trent-s13-eucharist-ch8-en: May the Eucharist be received sacramentally only, spiritually only, or both sacramentally and spiritually, and do laypeople receive communion from priests?
trent-s13-eucharist-preamble-en: Did the Synod assemble to set forth true doctrine on faith and the sacraments and to root out errors concerning the use and worship of the Eucharist?
trent-s13-eucharist-closing-decree-en: Must those burdened with mortal sin make sacramental confession, when a confessor may be had, before receiving the Eucharist?
trent-s14-extreme-unction-canon1-en: Is Extreme Unction truly and properly a sacrament instituted by Christ and promulgated by the apostle James, and not merely a human rite or figment?
trent-s14-penance-canon1-en: Is Penance in the Catholic Church truly and properly a sacrament instituted by Christ for reconciling the faithful to God after post-baptismal sin?
trent-s14-extreme-unction-canon2-en: Does the sacred unction of the sick confer grace, remit sin, and comfort the sick, rather than having ceased as a mere gift of cures?
trent-s14-penance-canon2-en: Are Baptism and Penance distinct sacraments, so that Penance is rightly called a second plank after shipwreck?
trent-s14-extreme-unction-canon3-en: Is the Roman Church's rite and usage of Extreme Unction in keeping with the apostle James, and not to be changed or contemned?
trent-s14-penance-canon3-en: Do Christ's words "whose sins you shall forgive…" refer to the power of forgiving and retaining sins in the Sacrament of Penance, not merely to preaching?
trent-s14-extreme-unction-canon4-en: Are the "presbyters" whom James bids anoint the sick ordained priests, so that a priest alone is the proper minister of Extreme Unction?
trent-s14-penance-canon5-en: Is contrition gained by examining and detesting one's sins, with purpose of amendment, a true and profitable sorrow that prepares for grace?
trent-s14-penance-canon6-en: Was sacramental confession instituted by divine right and necessary to salvation, including secret confession to a priest alone?
trent-s14-penance-canon7-en: Must one confess all remembered mortal sins and species-changing circumstances for the remission of sins in Penance, of divine right?
trent-s14-penance-canon8-en: Is the Church's confession of all sins possible and obligatory yearly for all the faithful, conformably to the Lateran constitution?
trent-s14-penance-canon9-en: Is the priest's sacramental absolution a judicial act requiring the penitent's confession, and not a bare declaration that sins are forgiven?
trent-s14-penance-canon10-en: Do priests in mortal sin still have the power of binding and loosing, and are priests alone the ministers of absolution?
trent-s14-penance-canon11-en: May bishops reserve cases to themselves so that a priest cannot truly absolve from those reserved cases without faculty?
trent-s14-penance-canon12-en: Does God always remit the whole punishment together with the guilt, so that the penitent's satisfaction is nothing but faith in Christ's satisfaction?
trent-s14-penance-canon13-en: Is temporal satisfaction for sins made to God through Christ's merits by patiently borne punishments, priestly penances, and voluntary works of piety?
trent-s14-penance-canon14-en: Are penitents' satisfactions through Jesus Christ a worship of God, and not mere human traditions that obscure grace?
trent-s14-penance-canon15-en: Were the keys given to the Church both to loose and to bind, so that priests may impose temporal punishments after eternal punishment is remitted?
trent-s14-extreme-unction-ch1-en: Was Extreme Unction instituted by Christ as a sacrament of the new law, recommended by James with oil blessed by a bishop as its matter?
trent-s14-extreme-unction-ch2-en: Does Extreme Unction confer the Holy Ghost's grace that cleanses sin, strengthens the sick person's soul, and may even restore bodily health?
trent-s14-extreme-unction-ch3-en: Are bishops or ordained priests the proper ministers of Extreme Unction, especially for those in danger of death?
trent-s14-extreme-unction-preamble-en: Is Extreme Unction the sacrament by which Christ guards the close of life, completing penance and the Christian life of perpetual penance?
trent-s14-penance-ch1-en: Was the sacrament of Penance instituted so that those who fall into sin after baptism may receive the benefit of Christ's death?
trent-s14-penance-ch2-en: Does Penance differ from Baptism in matter, form, and ministry, cleansing the baptized by judgment rather than by repeating baptism?
trent-s14-penance-ch3-en: Does the form of Penance consist in the minister's words "I absolve thee," with the penitent's contrition, confession, and satisfaction as its matter?
trent-s14-penance-ch4-en: Is contrition a sorrow of mind and detestation of sin committed, with purpose of not sinning again, necessary for obtaining pardon?
trent-s14-penance-ch5-en: Was entire confession of mortal sins instituted by the Lord and necessary by divine right for those who fall after baptism?
trent-s14-penance-ch6-en: Does the ministry of the keys in Penance belong only to bishops and priests, not to all the faithful indiscriminately?
trent-s14-penance-ch7-en: Is absolution without ordinary or delegated jurisdiction of no weight, and may higher pastors reserve graver cases?
trent-s14-penance-ch8-en: When God forgives guilt, does a temporal punishment often remain, so that satisfaction is still required of penitents?
trent-s14-penance-ch9-en: Can the faithful, through Jesus Christ, make satisfaction to God by voluntary penances, priestly penances, and patiently borne scourges?
trent-s14-penance-preamble-en: Did the Synod give a fuller definition of Penance to point out errors and make Catholic truth on that sacrament clear?
trent-s15-decree-for-proroguing-the-sess: Did the Synod prorogue publishing decrees on the Mass, Order, and reserved Eucharist articles while awaiting Protestants under safe-conduct?
trent-s15-safe-conduct-given-to-the-prot: Did the Synod grant Protestants an enlarged public safe-conduct to come freely to the Council?
trent-s15-safe-conduct-and-security-shal: Does the Synod's safe-conduct protect those received under its care during their stay and for a set time after their audience?
trent-s15-safe-conduct-that-they-might-c: Was publication deferred to the next Session so that those invited under safe-conduct might still come freely without hesitation?
trent-s16-bull-for-the-celebration-of-th: Did the pope, seeing heresy, schism, and moral corruption spread, provide for celebrating the Council of Trent anew?
trent-s16-decree-for-the-suspension-of-t: Did the Synod of Trent decree the suspension of the Council under the apostolic nuncios then presiding?
trent-s17-decree-for-celebrating-the-cou: Was the Council of Trent, all suspension removed, celebrated again from 18 January 1562 according to the form set for it?
trent-s17-indiction-of-the-next-session-: Was the next Session appointed for the Thursday after the second Sunday of Lent, 26 February?
trent-s18-extension-thereof-to-other-nat: Did the Synod extend the same public safe-conduct granted to the Germans to others of every nation not in communion with the Roman Church?
trent-s18-indiction-of-the-next-session-: Did the Synod decree that the next Session be held on the Thursday after Ascension?
trent-s18-on-the-public-faith-to-the-cou: Did the Synod aim, relying on Christ, to restore the Catholic faith's doctrine to its native purity against errors that defile it?
trent-s18-safe-conduct-granted-to-the-ge: Did the Synod grant the German nation a public safe-conduct guaranteeing security for those coming to the Council?
trent-s19-decree-for-the-prorogation-of-: Did the Synod prorogue to the Thursday after Corpus Christi the decrees that were to have been sanctioned that day?
trent-s20-decree-for-the-prorogation-of-: Did the Synod prorogue so that dogmas might be treated and ratified conjointly with matters of Reformation?
trent-s21-communion-canon1-en: Must all the faithful, by God's precept or necessity of salvation, receive both species of the Eucharist when not consecrating?
trent-s21-communion-canon2-en: Was the Catholic Church led by just causes to communicate laypeople and non-celebrating clerics under the species of bread only?
trent-s21-communion-canon3-en: Is Christ whole and entire received under the one species of bread, and not only when both species are received?
trent-s21-communion-canon4-en: Is communion of the Eucharist necessary for little children before they reach years of discretion?
trent-s21-communion-closing-decree-en: Did the Synod reserve undecided the questions whether the chalice may ever be conceded and on what conditions?
trent-s21-communion-ch1-en: Are laypeople and clerics not celebrating bound by divine right to communion under both species?
trent-s21-communion-ch2-en: Does the Church have power, the substance of the sacraments untouched, to ordain or change what she judges expedient in their dispensation?
trent-s21-communion-ch3-en: Are Christ whole and entire, and a true sacrament, received under either species of the Eucharist?
trent-s21-communion-ch4-en: Are little children who lack the use of reason bound by necessity to sacramental communion of the Eucharist?
trent-s21-communion-preamble-en: Did the Synod address errors about communion under both species and the communion of infants regarding the Eucharist?
trent-s22-mass-canon1-en: Is a true and proper sacrifice offered to God in the Mass, and not merely Christ given to us to eat?
trent-s22-mass-canon2-en: By the words "Do this for the commemoration of me," did Christ institute the apostles as priests to offer His body and blood?
trent-s22-mass-canon3-en: Is the Mass a propitiatory sacrifice that may be offered for the living and the dead, and not only praise, thanksgiving, or bare commemoration?
trent-s22-mass-canon4-en: Does the sacrifice of the Mass blaspheme or derogate from Christ's sacrifice consummated on the cross?
trent-s22-mass-canon5-en: Is it lawful to celebrate masses in honour of the saints and for obtaining their intercession with God, as the Church intends?
trent-s22-mass-canon6-en: Does the canon of the Mass contain errors that require it to be abrogated?
trent-s22-mass-canon7-en: Are the ceremonies, vestments, and outward signs used in celebrating Mass offices of piety rather than incentives to impiety?
trent-s22-mass-canon8-en: Are masses in which the priest alone communicates sacramentally lawful, and not to be abrogated?
trent-s22-mass-canon9-en: May part of the Roman canon be said in a low tone, and must Mass be only in the vulgar tongue, or water not be mixed with the wine?
trent-s23-orders-canon2-en: Besides the priesthood, are there other greater and minor orders in the Catholic Church by which advance is made to the priesthood?
trent-s23-orders-canon3-en: Is sacred ordination truly and properly a sacrament instituted by Christ, and not a human figment or mere rite for choosing ministers?
trent-s23-orders-canon4-en: Is the Holy Ghost given and an indelible character imprinted by sacred ordination, so that a priest cannot again become a layman?
trent-s23-orders-canon5-en: Is the sacred unction and other ceremonies of holy ordination required and not to be despised as pernicious?
trent-s23-orders-canon6-en: Is there in the Catholic Church a hierarchy by divine ordination consisting of bishops, priests, and ministers?
trent-s23-orders-canon7-en: Are bishops superior to priests, with the power of confirming and ordaining, even without the people's or secular power's consent?
trent-s23-orders-canon8-en: Are bishops assumed by authority of the Roman Pontiff legitimate and true bishops, and not a human figment?
trent-s23-orders-ch1-en: Are sacrifice and priesthood so conjoined by God's ordinance that the New Testament Church has a priesthood from Christ's institution?
trent-s23-orders-ch2-en: Are there seven orders arranged as steps so that the ministry of the priesthood may be exercised with greater worthiness?
trent-s23-orders-ch3-en: Is Order truly and properly a sacrament that confers grace by sacred ordination performed with words and outward signs?
trent-s23-orders-ch4-en: Does the sacrament of Order imprint an indelible character, and do New Testament priests have more than a temporary power?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon1-en: Is matrimony truly and properly one of the seven sacraments of the evangelic law, instituted by Christ and conferring grace?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon2-en: Is it unlawful for Christians to have several wives at the same time, as prohibited by divine law?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon3-en: Can the Church establish degrees of consanguinity and affinity beyond those in Leviticus that hinder or dissolve marriage, and dispense in some?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon4-en: Could the Church establish impediments that dissolve marriage, or has she erred in establishing them?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon5-en: May the bond of matrimony be dissolved for heresy, irksome cohabitation, or the affected absence of one party?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon6-en: Is a ratified but unconsummated marriage dissolved by one party's solemn profession of religion?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon8-en: May the Church, for many causes, allow separation of husband and wife as to bed or cohabitation for a time?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon9-en: Can clerics in sacred orders or solemnly professed Regulars validly contract marriage despite ecclesiastical law or vow?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon10-en: Is virginity or celibacy better and more blessed than the marriage state, rather than marriage being placed above them?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon11-en: May the Church forbid solemnizing marriages at certain times and use benedictions and ceremonies therein without tyranny or superstition?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon12-en: Do matrimonial causes belong to ecclesiastical judges?
trent-s24-matrimony-decree-en: Is the bond of matrimony perpetual and indissoluble, uniting two only as one flesh as taught from Adam's words and confirmed by the Lord?
vie-decree1-en: Did the only-begotten Son, true God with the Father, assume in the Virgin's womb a passible human body and a rational soul that truly informs the body, becoming true man?
vie-decree2-en: May abbots and religious holding major office sue, by apostolic letters, only in places and before judges allowed when acting about priories subject to them?
vie-decree3-en: May a bishop's chief official or a conventual prior be delegated by the apostolic see, with limits on when that practice applies?
vie-decree4-en: If religious prelates neglect to fill vacant priories or benefices in time, may local diocesan bishops supply for that negligence?
vie-decree5-en: Must those obliged to divine office in cathedrals or collegiate churches receive sacred orders to have a voice in chapter?
vie-decree6-en: In cases of elections, postulations, or provisions, may costly prolongation of lawsuits by overprecise judicial order be checked?
vie-decree7-en: May bishops driven from their sees by the ungodly exercise jurisdiction outside their own diocese when fear keeps them away?
vie-decree8-en: Must ordinaries admonish clerics who publicly work as butchers or keep taverns to cease, under penalty if they persist?
vie-decree9-en: Does a cleric who publicly abandons his order's dress for striped or variegated clothing without good reason lose that order's privileges?
vie-decree10-en: Was Boniface VIII's revoked decretal restored because Benedict XI's revocation failed to bring the hoped-for peace?
vie-decree11-en: May religious usurp tithes on newly tilled land or other tithes owed to churches to which they have no legal claim?
vie-decree12-en: When a temporary tithe on benefices is granted, should it be raised by the region's customary valuation and current money, sparing chalices and books?
vie-decree13-en: To aid perseverance in poverty and peace among those moving to non-mendicant orders, may ambition that breeds discord among them be checked by decree?
vie-decree14-en: Did the council forbid unbecoming practices among the black monks so that honour and integrity might flourish in that order?
vie-decree15-en: Must those who have vowed themselves to Christ keep religious discipline, lest contempt of it stain religious life?
vie-decree16-en: Are women called Beguines, who promise no obedience, renounce no goods, and profess no approved rule, true religious merely by dress?
vie-decree17-en: Must those in charge of hospices, leper-houses, almshouses, or hospitals care for them and recover usurped goods rather than let them be lost?
vie-decree18-en: May anyone be admitted to a church at exempt religious' presentation unless a portion of its revenues is assigned before the diocesan?
vie-decree19-en: Must religious who hold monasteries or churches pay the procurations and burdens attached to those advantages?
vie-decree20-en: May visiting prelates at Cistercian monasteries demand food beyond the monastic rule, contrary to the order's privileges?
vie-decree21-en: Must local ordinaries publish sentences of excommunication and interdict against those who, on their own or by command, violate them?
vie-decree22-en: Should negligent rectors be corrected when their subjects, and ministers casting aside clerical modesty, go unpunished in bad behaviour?
vie-decree23-en: May clerics of a cardinal's or bishop's household join them in the divine office under the concession granted for that purpose?
vie-decree24-en: Should the Church strive, with God's grace, to lead those in error into the way of truth and win them for God?
vie-decree25-en: Is it an insult to the faith that Saracen priests called Zabazala publicly carry out their temple rites in lands under Christian princes?
vie-decree26-en: Have some inquisitors overstepped the power given them to suppress heresy, enlarging their authority beyond wise apostolic limits?
vie-decree27-en: May nobody below the age of forty be entrusted with the office of inquisitor of heresy?
vie-decree28-en: Did the council condemn the sect of Beghards and related wicked errors as abominable and to be rooted out of Christian soil?
vie-decree29-en: May communities by statute approve usury or decide that usury once paid need not be fully restored?
vie-decree30-en: May prelates seize and imprison exempt religious when the law does not permit it, disturbing their peace?
vie-decree32-en: May an archbishop passing through exempt localities of his diocese have the cross carried before him, bless the people, and hear offices there?
vie-decree33-en: Does one who wrongfully strikes, seizes, or banishes a bishop, or aids such sacrilege, incur the grave penalties set for that crime?
vie-decree34-en: May temporal rulers capture ecclesiastics until they resign benefices, or block those summoned to the apostolic see?
vie-decree35-en: Do added penalties bind those who transgress the constitution forbidding mendicants to acquire houses or places unlawfully?
vie-decree36-en: May nobles under interdict have masses publicly celebrated in their house chapels or elsewhere despite the interdict?
vie-decree37-en: May Friars Minor, during interdict, receive third-order brothers and sisters into their churches for divine offices when that causes scandal?
vie-decree38-en: Did the Word of God establish within the Church militant a sheltered "garden" where people may more peacefully contemplate and imitate His heavenly life?
lat5-s1-the-bull-convoking-the-council-s: Were the bulls convoking and postponing the council read, and masses, prayers, officers, and seating arrangements ordered for its sessions?
lat5-s2-the-quasi-council-of-pisa-is-con: Is the quasi-council of Pisa condemned, with everything done there declared null, as the Lateran council proceeds against schism?
lat5-s3-each-and-all-of-the-measures-spo: Were measures sponsored by the schismatic cardinals rejected as the Lateran council continued after new adherence and union with it?
lat5-s4-p1-en: Were the Pragmatic Sanction revoked and the acts of the quasi-council of Pisa regarding it annulled, along with curial reform?
lat5-s5-bull-renewing-and-confirming-the: Must every trace of simony be absent from the election of the Roman pontiff who presides over the Christian people?
lat5-s6-safeconduct-for-those-who-wish-a: Was safe-conduct granted so that those who wish and ought to come to the council might do so for the Church's unity and peace?
lat5-s7-p1-en: Was the constitution Meditatio cordis nostri, postponing the eighth session to 16 November, read out and approved?
lat5-s8-condemnation-of-every-propositio: Are pernicious errors on the nature of the rational soul, long rejected by the faithful, to be condemned as contrary to Christian truth?
lat5-s8-on-arranging-peace-between-chris: Should Christian kings and princes make peace among themselves so that strife and bloodshed among Christians may cease?
lat5-s8-bull-on-reform-en: Did the council pursue reform of the Roman curia's officials in response to constant complaints about them?
lat5-s9-the-pope-urges-christian-rulers-: Must Christian rulers end armed conflicts that devastate Christian lands, for the salvation and peace of the Church?
lat5-s9-bull-on-reform-of-the-curia-en: Should the Roman pontiff reform worsening church discipline and morals among nearly all ranks of the faithful?
lat5-s10-on-the-reform-of-credit-organis: May credit organisations called Montes pietatis be approved as healthy and Christian once scandalous practices about them are cut away?
lat5-s10-bull-against-exempt-persons-in-: Should indults and privileges of exempt persons be regulated so scandals between prelates and subjects are avoided?
lat5-s10-on-printing-books-en: Because printing spreads many books cheaply for study, must the Church take care that this art serve truth and not lead people astray?
lat5-s10-on-setting-a-date-for-those-ack: Was a date set for those of the French nation acknowledging the Pragmatic Sanction to appear regarding its status before the council?
lat5-s11-on-how-to-preach-en: Must preaching in the Church be exercised rightly, from charity and according to the holy fathers' precepts and examples?
lat5-s11-bull-containing-agreements-betw: Were agreements between the pope and the most Christian king confirmed for the peaceful government of kingdoms and the apostolic see?
lat5-s11-on-the-abrogation-of-the-pragma: Must Christians obey the Roman pontiff as Peter's successor, so that abandoning his teaching places one outside the Church?
lat5-s11-on-religious-and-their-privileg: Should the labours of bishops and mendicant friars for the faith and souls be encouraged, including regarding religious' privileges?
lat5-s12-against-those-attacking-the-hou: Are those who violently attack cardinals' houses and possessions to be restrained by strengthened safeguards for that office?
lat5-s12-constitution-imposing-taxes-and: Did the council, while closing, impose taxes and provide so cathedrals not remain without pastors and reform be observed?
con1-canon1-en: Shall the faith of the 318 Fathers of Nicaea remain firm, and every heresy—especially Eunomian, Arian, and Semi-Arian—be anathematized?
con1-canon2-en: Must bishops stay within their own dioceses, with Alexandria administering Egypt and Eastern bishops managing the East alone?
con1-canon3-en: Shall the Bishop of Constantinople have the prerogative of honour after the Bishop of Rome, because Constantinople is New Rome?
